I am old now and my bones are tired, so I cannot work like I used to. This small piece of land has fed my family for many years, and I will care for it as I always have. I will put cow dung on the soil because I do not have money for chemical fertilizer from the shop, and I will plant the maize seed I saved from last year's harvest. My children and grandchildren will help me with the digging and weeding, since I cannot afford to hire anyone and the plot is too small to need outside hands.
